defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Review stage tool policy forbids artifact_write but reviewers must emit review_findings.json artifacts, making the workflow impossible as specified.

evidence.note: Review stage sets artifact_write to deny

payload.reroute_reason: Critical tool policy conflict: Review stage must allow artifact_write for findings-only artifacts (review_findings.json). Governance stage policies require revision to distinguish findings-only artifact writes from general artifact writes, or to explicitly allowlist review_findings.json as a permitted canonical artifact type for reviewers.
